mapper.sql: C.COMM_CODE , C.COMD_CODE , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(C.COMD_ENNM, ''), C.COMD_NAME) ELSE C.COMD_NAME END AS COMD_NAME , C.CODE_EXPL , C.OPT1_CODE , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(C.OPT1_ENNM, ''), C.OPT1_NAME) ELSE C.OPT1_NAME END AS OPT1_NAME , C.OPT2_CODE , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(C.OPT2_ENNM, ''), C.OPT2_NAME) ELSE C.OPT2_NAME END AS OPT2_NAME , C.OPT3_CODE , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(C.OPT3_ENNM, ''), C.OPT3_NAME) ELSE C.OPT3_NAME END AS OPT3_NAME , C.OPT4_CODE , CASE WHEN #{englishYsno} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(C.OPT4_ENNM, ''), C.OPT4_NAME) ELSE C.OPT4_NAME END AS OPT4_NAME , C.USEE_YSNO , C.SORT_ORDR
mapper.select:
SELECT /* getCodeList */
FROM TB_CODEXD C WHERE C.COMM_CODE = #{commCode} AND COALESCE(C.USEE_YSNO, #{commYes}) = #{commYes} ORDER BY C.SORT_ORDR IS NULL , C.SORT_ORDR , C.COMD_CODE
